messages:
sam_sales: Quick ask from Acme POC: they want USB delivery + signed bundles. Need clear SOW bullets for signing options, hotfix SLA, billing model (delivery vs applied), and SBOM handling. Can we outline?
olga_se: Options: (1) Redwood-signed bundles (HSM-backed, detached sigs), customer imports Redwood root; (2) Customer-side signing kit (we provide tooling + verification process). Both ok, different liability.
matt_sre: Ops notes: for large models use chunked bundles + resumable apply. Always include per-file SHA256 in manifest. Pre-apply snapshot + rollback token are mandatory for offline installs. Example verify cmd:
```
sha256sum -c redwood-bundle.manifest && openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
```
sam_sales: Hotfix SLA? Acme wants 24h signed artifact and same-day courier pickup. Feasible?
matt_sre: We can promise signed artifact within 24h under enterprise SLA with expedited fee. Courier pickup is their logistics; we'll provide tamper-evident packaging checklist.
nora_legal: Contract bullets: emergency signing within 24h subject to expedited fee and customer confirmation of pickup window. Include clause that Redwood not liable for transit delays and require chain-of-custody acceptance. Also flag export-control/compliance disclosure for certain cryptography libs.
olga_se: Billing: recommend bundle issuance fee + optional per-device maintenance (covers N deltas/month). Billing on "applied" requires an offline receipt workflow (redwood-apply-report) that customer uploads later; otherwise bill on delivery.
ops-bot: ops-bot: created ticket SALES-8210 (deliverables: 1-page ops checklist, SOW snippets for signing options + emergency modifier, fee schedule).
sam_sales: Great — can we have drafts in this thread by EOD? I need to send to Acme for sign-off. :pray:
matt_sre: I'll post the ops checklist (commands, expected apply time, rollback steps) in ~2 hours.
nora_legal: I'll drop the contract snippets and the emergency modifier language by EOD.
olga_se: I'll add packaging size limits and chunking recommendations (max 50GB parts, resumable apply) and note KV-cache migration caveat
